changelog:
• Mini-Player Close Button: Optional dedicated close (✕) button directly on the mini-player (in Developer Settings) to stop playback and dismiss the player.
• Header Icon Order: Interchanged top-right icons on Home (Spotify Sync & Settings) and Library (Stats & Settings) for better reachability.
• Smart Route History: Hardware back button now gracefully steps back through Library sub-tabs, full player visualizer/lyrics/queue modes, and search screens.
• Custom App Icons: Built-in visual icon picker supporting Emerald, Minimal Dark, Gold Luxury, Neon Cyberpunk, or Crimson Passion.
• Storage Permissions: Save downloaded tracks anywhere in internal storage (e.g. /Music) with All Files Access.
• Audio Focus Management: Smooth audio ducking and auto-pause during calls, navigation, or notifications.
• Bluetooth Auto-Resume: Automatically resume playback when reconnecting to car audio or Bluetooth headphones.
• Network Stall Protection: Option to auto-skip unplayable songs on slow or unstable network connections.
• Clean Spotify-style Playlist: Streamlined tracklist with on-demand edit/reorder mode.
• Bitrate Badge: High-fidelity audio quality badge now active by default across mini and full player.
• Anonymous Feedback: Send bug reports or suggestions with optional screenshot attachments directly from Settings.
